command:
bash -c 
export PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8
export PYTHONUTF8=1
SSH_KEY="/c/Users/md1avn/.ssh/id_ed25519"
SSH_HOST="ssh7.vast.ai"
SSH_PORT=11678
REMOTE="root@${SSH_HOST}"

cat > /tmp/remote_launch.sh <<"REMOTE_EOF"
set -e
which tmux
tmux -V

# Kill any existing nsga2 session
tmux kill-session -t nsga2 2>/dev/null || true

# Launch nsga2 session
cd /root/t0115_workdir/repo
tmux new-session -d -s nsga2 -c /root/t0115_workdir/repo
tmux send-keys -t nsga2 "export PYTHONPATH=/root/t0115_workdir/repo" Enter
tmux send-keys -t nsga2 "cd /root/t0115_workdir/repo" Enter
tmux send-keys -t nsga2 "bash tasks/t0115_seed9354_no_autostop/code/run_seed9354.sh 2>&1 | tee /root/t0115_workdir/run_seed9354.log" Enter

sleep 3
echo --- tmux sessions ---
tmux list-sessions
echo --- pane content first 30 lines ---
tmux capture-pane -t nsga2 -p | head -30
REMOTE_EOF

scp -i "${SSH_KEY}" -P "${SSH_PORT}" -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no /tmp/remote_launch.sh "${REMOTE}:/tmp/remote_launch.sh"
ssh -i "${SSH_KEY}" -p "${SSH_PORT}" -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no "${REMOTE}" "bash /tmp/remote_launch.sh"
